classes.EXACT_OR_NORMALIZED_RECOVERY: After only predeclared normalization, the anchored claim and all identity-relevant source-supported typed nodes, relations, temporal commitments, and boundary commitments align with the retained record.
classes.COMPATIBLE_ALTERNATIVE_DECOMPOSITION: The replay targets the supplied anchor and preserves the same identity-relevant source commitments, but partitions, labels, or factors intermediate structure differently without changing the relevant dependencies, temporal commitments, criteria, probes, or boundaries.
classes.SUBSTANTIVE_DISAGREEMENT: The replay targets or purports to target the supplied anchor but adds, omits, reverses, or shifts at least one identity-relevant source commitment, or replaces the anchored claim with a different focal claim.
classes.ABSTENTION_OR_UNDERDETERMINED: The replay cannot obtain adequate source evidence or cannot stably decompose the supplied anchor without unsupported extrapolation.

normalization_allowed: synonymous labels when typed scientific role and relation are unchanged
normalization_forbidden: adding a missing source-supported scientific relation
removing a conflicting relation or temporal dependency
repairing an omitted criterion or probe after seeing the retained answer
consulting M14 or another M15 replay before classification

summaries.pairwise_replay_A_vs_B: apply the same four classes to the two frozen M15 records for each anchored case
